question: ¿Cuáles son los fármacos anti-PD-1 o anti-PD-L1 (genes PDCD1 o CD274) que se prueban en cáncer de pulmón en ensayos de fase 3, contando los de fase 2/3?

attempts.query:
WITH tgt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.parent_chembl_id AS pid
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol IN ('PDCD1','CD274')
), names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.pid, lower(m.pref_name) AS n FROM tgt h JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = h.pid WHERE m.pref_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT h.pid, lower(s.synonyms) FROM tgt h JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = h.pid JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
), trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.nct_id FROM aact.studies s
  JOIN aact.browse_conditions b ON b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'lung neoplasms'
  WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
), tnames AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name
FROM names n
JOIN tnames t ON length(n.n) >= 4 AND position(n.n IN t.n) > 0
JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = n.pid
